text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me if you have noticed any bleeding from your gums, nose, or in your urine, and have you had any recent weight loss or night sweats? I also need to know if you have any swollen or tender lumps, particularly in your neck, armpits, or groin.

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the child have any visible swelling in her abdomen or any palpable lumps in her neck, armpits, or groin? I would also like to know if the bone pain is localized to specific areas like the long bones of the legs or ribs.
